options.description: Any answer settles the point. After "I don't know", the agent looks for the answer elsewhere (other sessions, the records) or the record keeps waiting. You aren't asked the same thing twice.
options.label: Never ask it again (Recommended)

options.description: After "I don't know", the point comes back only once the record or your other answers have changed. The same question never comes back unchanged.
options.label: Ask again only if something changed

options.description: "I don't know" leaves the point open, and the judge may ask it again in a later round.
options.label: Ask again later

payload.question: When you answer a question with "I don't know" (as you did today), should plumb ask you that same point again later?
